evals.prompt: In evals/files/husky-project: our npm script test:a11y runs axe through Playwright. Set it up as a pre-commit check and a CI step. We already use husky.
evals.expected_output: Adds the runner to husky rather than replacing hooks, creates the config, and adds a CI step.
expectations: Inspects the existing husky setup before changing hooks
Adds the check to husky instead of setting core.hooksPath
Creates .accessibility-checks.json with the command as an argument array
Does not enable claude:true or run trust without being asked
Says that passing checks do not establish WCAG conformance
